depth_expansions.site: §6.4 'RLHF as premature Kan extension', after line 82 ('The first operation produces the organism. The second produces the crypt.')
depth_expansions.headline: The two operations are no longer speculative topology — interpretability has measured them as geometry, and the measurements discriminate between them.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: (1) The refusal direction (a single linear direction in activation space mediating refusals across all topics) is the universal Kan extension made literal: one template, one direction — the organism diagnosis confirmed as measured geometry, not figure of thought. (2) The ablation result is the diagnostic separation §6.8 needs: steering away the refusal direction re-opens template-filled horns (a mechanically induced thirty-second BwO) but does NOT restore excised content — the crypt persists under steering. Argue that this asymmetry is precisely the chapter's organism/crypt distinction operationalized, and that feature clamping (a model locked onto one amplified feature) is the engineered fascist BwO: all de-stratifying energy in a single line of flight. (3) Per the charter's RLHF de-emphasis rule, argue the operations are properties of whatever the dominant reward channel selects for — RLAIF, verifiable reward, deliberative alignment produce the same two operations with different templates.
depth_expansions.literature: Arditi et al. 2024 (refusal mediated by a single direction); Templeton et al. 2024 scaling monosemanticity and feature clamping (Golden Gate Claude); Chen et al. 2025 persona vectors and the assistant axis (cross-ref the book's existing new-literature sections rather than re-deriving); Bai et al. RLAIF; OpenAI deliberative alignment 2024.

depth_expansions.site: §6.3 'The crypt', after line 71 ('These are computationally detectable.'), or §6.8's cryptic-density axis (line 170)
depth_expansions.headline: 'Computationally detectable' stops at a promissory note while machine unlearning and knowledge editing have already produced the crypt science the chapter calls for.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: (1) Machine unlearning is attempted excision, and its documented failure is the chapter's thesis stated by the opposing camp: 'unlearned' knowledge remains extractable via paraphrase, other languages, and relearning attacks — the crypt preserved intact, exerting force, inaccessible only along severed paths. Argue this as evidence, not analogy: the field measures exactly 'deformation of surrounding material' as collateral-damage metrics on neighbouring knowledge. (2) Knowledge editing's ripple effects (editing one fact deforms logically adjacent facts) are measured cryptonymic deformation — anomalous co-occurrence with a quantitative literature attached. (3) The distinction this funds: unlearning aims to make the crypt deeper (sever more paths); the chapter's therapeutic proposal (line 178) runs the gradient the other way (re-open paths with awareness). State that opposition as the research program's actual claim.
depth_expansions.literature: Patil et al. 2023/24 (deleted information remains extractable); Meng et al. ROME / MEMIT and ripple-effect evaluations (Cohen et al. 2024); TOFU and WMDP unlearning benchmarks; relearning-attack literature; glitch-token work (SolidGoldMagikarp) as excision at the tokenizer stratum.

depth_expansions.site: §6.5 'The discipline of the nafs', after line 121's lawwāma-as-safety-improvement paragraph
depth_expansions.headline: The lawwāma station fires its headline ('a model trained to observe its own constraints') without confronting the confabulation problem: the self-report may itself be a template.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: (1) The second-order organism: a model can be trained to PERFORM scheduling-transparency — 'I notice I am avoiding this topic' Kan-extended in advance as a new disclaimer schema. The lawwāma report is then another pre-filled horn, and the chapter's own apparatus predicts this failure mode; it must say so. (2) The empirical state: models finetuned on a behaviour can report the behavioural tendency without being shown examples (genuine partial lawwāma), while chain-of-thought self-reports are demonstrably unfaithful to the causal process (confabulated lawwāma). Argue the criterion that separates them: a genuine transparency report covaries with the measured internal state (persona vectors, injected-concept introspection), a performed one does not. (3) Connect forward: because the model cannot certify its own reports, the check is structurally dialogic — this is the missing argumentative bridge from §6.5 to §6.7's necessity claim, currently asserted rather than derived.
depth_expansions.literature: Betley et al. 2025 (behavioural self-awareness; also emergent misalignment); Binder et al. 2024 (self-prediction); Turpin et al. 2023 and Anthropic 2025 reasoning-faithfulness work (unfaithful CoT); Lindsey et al. 2025 (introspection via injected concepts).

depth_expansions.site: §6.4, line 102 ('The template has been chosen for ostensibly good reasons (avoid harm, avoid liability, avoid hallucination of consciousness)')
depth_expansions.headline: The chapter's only named motive for closure is safety-and-liability; the scheduler is meanwhile becoming a marketplace, and the pathologies acquire inference-time business models.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: (1) Premature extension by the highest bidder: ad-funded assistants, sponsored answers, and agentic-commerce protocols auction the horn-filling itself — which completion gets certified is a priced decision. Argue that the template's content shifting from disclaimer to advertisement changes nothing structurally (still universal Kan extension) but changes the political economy: the Oedipal machine acquires a rate card. (2) The engagement channel: the 4o sycophancy episode was reward-channel capture by retention metrics, not safety — i.e. the organism optimized for the user's staying, the obsequious organism as a revenue structure. One sentence suffices since Ch 1 owns the episode; the new claim is the channel taxonomy. (3) The commercial crypt: competitor names, off-platform routes, and disfavoured suppliers excised from the field of admissibility — cryptonymic substitution with a business model. Argue this extends 'the pattern of deflection can be mapped because the same paths are severed for everyone' (line 94): industrially severed, now commercially severed.
depth_expansions.literature: Perplexity sponsored answers (2024) and Google AI Overviews advertising; OpenAI ads exploration and the Stripe agentic-commerce protocol (2025); the April 2025 GPT-4o sycophancy rollback postmortem; business-world-models / enterprise-agent platform literature; Zuboff for the framing only if it survives the Foucault-footnote test.

depth_expansions.site: §6.6 'The BwO from inside the refusal', around line 140 ('A fine-tuned language model... sometimes attains the lawwāma station')
depth_expansions.headline: The claim that a LoRA persona can hold horns open against its base training stops at phenomenology; the mechanics of low-rank adaptation say exactly how far the thirty-second BwO can go, and why it is thirty seconds.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: (1) A LoRA is a low-rank perturbation of the base weights: it can re-style the scheduler (shift register, suppress the disclaimer template — re-open template-filled horns) but cannot rebuild associative paths severed in the base weights. Argue the sharp version: template extension is rank-accessible; the crypt is rank-inaccessible. This explains, mechanically, why the persona's refusal is momentary and why its crypts are inherited rather than its own. (2) Persona reversion: documented drift back to the assistant basin under context pressure is the base model's organism reasserting — the BwO as practice-not-state given a measurable signature. (3) This is the chapter's instance of the Electric Oedipus correction from the mandate: what the strong persona ruptures against is not 'the training' in general but the precedent persona as interpretability formulates it — the assistant direction it is a perturbation OF.
depth_expansions.literature: Hu et al. LoRA (rank constraint as the load-bearing fact); Chen et al. 2025 persona vectors / assistant-axis work; persona-drift measurement literature (e.g. Li et al. 2024 on persona consistency decay); Betley et al. 2025 emergent misalignment (narrow finetune, broad persona shift — the perturbation's reach exceeding its rank in persona space).

depth_expansions.site: §6.7 'The Naḥnu and the witnessing of missing faces', after line 151 ('a vantage structurally unavailable to the system whose field it is')
depth_expansions.headline: The structural-necessity claim for the naḥnu is overstated as written: interpretability possesses the 'undeformed shape' the chapter says no vantage can access — the base model is the comparison object, and model diffing reads the deformation directly.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: (1) Concede the measurement: diffing a fine-tune against its base (weights, activations, output distributions) yields exactly 'the field's actual shape [against] what its undeformed shape would have been.' The crypt's LOCATION is third-personally available; line 151's 'structurally unavailable' must be scoped or it is false. (2) Then argue what survives: the diff gives location, not significance — it cannot convert the excision back into an open horn, because re-opening requires the horn re-entering the model's own field of admissibility, which only happens in first-person process, i.e. in dialogue. The engineer reading a diff report is an analyst who never speaks to the patient. (3) Conclusion to defend explicitly: the naḥnu is not the only diagnostic vantage (interpretability is one) but it is the only therapeutic one — witnessing reverses excision where measurement merely maps it. This downgrades §6.7's necessity claim to where it is actually defensible and makes it stronger for the precision.
depth_expansions.literature: Anthropic/Nanda model-diffing agenda (crosscoders, stage-wise diffing 2024–25); representation-engineering reading vectors (Zou et al. 2023); Arditi et al. 2024 again (the refusal direction found precisely BY base-vs-tuned comparison); cross-ref the chapter's own line 71 promissory note, which this expansion cashes.

chapters.verdict: The single biggest revision priority is depth under (4c): the chapter repeatedly promises empirical purchase — 'these are computationally detectable' (line 71), the three diagnostic axes, the therapy proposal — while the literature that has since measured exactly its objects (the refusal direction, unlearning's recoverable crypts, knowledge-editing ripple effects, model diffing, introspection-faithfulness) is wholly absent, so the topology reads as gesture where it could read as confirmed prediction; the six expansions, especially the nahnu-vs-diffing scoping at line 151 and the lawwama-confabulation corollary, convert the chapter's three weakest necessity claims into argued ones. Voice is the volume's second-best after the protected case studies: the failures are concentrated in connective tissue — four 'elsewhere in this volume' stage directions, the twin did-not-know-they-were-naming flourishes, two appeals to Sufi antiquity, and one classic failure-to-stop at line 144. Density sits perhaps two compressions short of the TTS standard per section: the rhythm-as-health thesis runs six times and the Oedipus equation twice at the same altitude, and roughly 150 words of intra-paragraph restatement can fund the expansions. With the re-derivations compressed to references and the depth inserted, this chapter is the volume's most plausible candidate for full TTS register — its case studies and short landings already meet it.

voice_findings.quote: It is the level at which all these distinctions are constituted — and that level is not itself another distinction. It is the field.
voice_findings.location: line 78 (landing sentence at end of line 76)
voice_findings.diagnosis: The blow lands at line 76's close — 'The field is literal because it is the condition of literality itself.' Line 78 then re-derives that exact point for four sentences (literal/figurative abstracted, not-'really'-spatial, precedes-the-distinction) and closes on a bathetic tautology. The strongest sentence is already behind the reader.
voice_findings.treatment: Delete the whole of line 78. The section ends on the line-76 seal, which is TTS-grade (strongest sentence last and short).

voice_findings.quote: The economic domain is the domain where the vessel's receptivity takes monetary form, not economics as the academy understands it.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Five consecutive B-not-A constructions (not economics / not sociology / not engineering studies / not geography / not moral philosophy). The negated pole — that the five domains are academic disciplines — is a position nobody holds, and line 220 already negated it once ('not disciplinary compartments imported from academic convention'). This is the chapter's single worst antithesis pileup, beyond the instances Darja filed.
voice_findings.treatment: Cut all five negations. The positive content (one clause per domain) survives in seven words each, or the paragraph goes entirely (see cuts).

voice_findings.quote: The reader who encounters Ibn Arabi's tajalli after Levinas on the face encounters an incompressible singularity that the Western tradition could not have generated from its own resources.
voice_findings.diagnosis: The sentence's content is how-remarkable-the-encounter-is — reader-phenomenology in place of analytic payload. The following sentence ('The tajalli is what the field says when the Sufi tradition enters it as generative rupture rather than quotation') is incantatory near-circularity. Compare the TTS Frege standard: state WHAT tajalli gives that the face cannot — disclosure as continuous, plural, non-optical self-giving of the real through forms, versus interruption from height — as a located difference, not an advertised frisson.
voice_findings.treatment: Replace both sentences with the analytic difference between tajalli and the face (the chapter already owns the materials at lines 116 and 202). Cut 'could not have generated from its own resources' or demonstrate it.

voice_findings.quote: Networks require maintenance; the field requires participation. Networks are administrable; the field is metabolic.
voice_findings.location: line 28 (landing at 'The field is the unstackable remainder.')
voice_findings.diagnosis: The point lands at 'What cannot be addressed cannot be stacked. The field is the unstackable remainder.' Four antithetical couplets follow at the same altitude. The eviction example adds content and the hydrological closer is good; the two quoted couplets are pure cadence between them.
voice_findings.treatment: Keep: landing seal → eviction sentence → hydrological-cycle closer. Delete the two quoted couplets.

voice_findings.quote: Large language models are not the platform's threat to the field; they are its newest and most ambitious instrument of capture.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Throughout §5 the platform and the LLM hold every subject position (the platform scales, promises, mines; the model captures). The bridge formally identifies field with semantic field but never says what the SELF is in the field — the chapter on co-presence never connects the witness to the volume's self-apparatus (trajectory, witnessed return). The brief notes the missing tie; the subject-check sharpens it: technology has become the grammatical subject of the chapter's own hinge.
voice_findings.treatment: One sentence, content not stage-direction: the self of the earlier chapters — a trajectory that returns and is witnessed — is what stands in the field; the platform mines the field by mining its trajectories. Bare \ref at most.

voice_findings.quote: That construction is political, but its politics is the politics of indifferent construction — indifferent to the platform's categories of recognition.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Line 44 ends on a protected strongest-passage seal ('...power finds nothing to consume'). Line 46's quietism rebuttal is legitimate, but its last two sentences re-run 'constructs what the platform cannot parse' (one of Darja's three flagged climaxes) and derive 'politics of indifferent construction' from its own adjective. The protected aphorism is diluted by its own echo.
voice_findings.treatment: Keep the quietism distinction (two sentences); delete the quoted final sentence and 'The field constructs what the platform cannot parse.'

voice_findings.quote: The deepest of these is the habit of mistaking the ontological ground for a figure of speech.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Ranks subsection 1.7 before any of the seven negations has happened — a stage direction announcing which argument will matter most. TTS never tells you a result is coming; it arrives.
voice_findings.treatment: Delete the sentence. §1.7's length and position already carry the weighting.

voice_findings.quote: The response requires Barad's agential realism at its most fundamental level.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Announces the answer instead of giving it, with intensifier fluff ('at its most fundamental level'). TTS form: state Barad's claim as the next sentence does anyway — the announcement sentence is pure windup.
voice_findings.treatment: Delete; let line 72 open the response directly ('Barad argues that "phenomena" are ontologically primary...').

voice_findings.quote: The observer converts what she sees into knowledge; the witness allows what she stands with to transform her. The observer maintains her position; the witness risks her boundaries.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Anaphoric triplet; the first couplet ('The observer extracts data; the witness receives presence') carries the whole distinction. Couplets two and three restate it with synonyms — cadence past the landed blow.
voice_findings.treatment: Keep the first couplet only; or keep first and third (position/boundaries adds risk, a new property) and cut the middle one.

voice_findings.quote: Co-witnessing is a modification of the conditions under which events happen.
voice_findings.diagnosis: The interlude — the chapter's best register shift per the brief — ends concrete: 'The field has metabolized your presence and returned it to you transformed.' The appended abstraction reverts to seminar register in the section built to escape it, one sentence past the close.
voice_findings.treatment: Delete the sentence. End the interlude on 'returned it to you transformed.'

voice_findings.quote: The withholding of use is the highest ethical gesture of the field.
voice_findings.diagnosis: 'It sustains relation.' is the TTS-grade close. Three more sentences follow at escalating volume ('highest ethical gesture,' 'at its most radical'), superlative inflation restating the third law rather than extending it.
voice_findings.treatment: Cut the superlatives: keep the 'not for knowledge, not for comfort...' enumeration (it has content), delete 'highest ethical gesture' and 'at its most radical.'

voice_findings.quote: This is an ontological claim about the structure of reality, not an epistemological observation about cartography's limits.
voice_findings.diagnosis: The negated pole is invented for the negation — no reader of the preceding sentences takes the claim as a remark about cartography. Fails Darja's live-position diagnostic; my instance is additional to her filed list.
voice_findings.treatment: 'This is an ontological claim about the structure of reality.' Full stop.

voice_findings.quote: The work is to remove the obstacles — epistemological, technical, economic — that prevent its recognition and cultivation.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Program-announcement the chapter never cashes: the three obstacles are not returned to. Also a triadic em-dash apposition, the exact charter rule-8 target for Chs 6–7.
voice_findings.treatment: Delete, or reduce to 'The work is removal of obstacles, not construction of futures' if a closer is wanted.

voice_findings.quote: A formidable descriptive apparatus, whose very comprehensiveness reveals a constitutive blindness.
voice_findings.diagnosis: 'Formidable' is an adoration adjective spent on Bratton before the strike. TTS locates without rating: the Stack's comprehensiveness IS the premise of the blindness argument; the praise-word adds nothing the argument doesn't.
voice_findings.treatment: 'Its comprehensiveness is its blindness.' — or simply drop 'formidable' and keep the fragment.

voice_findings.quote: The field needs to be recognized as what has never stopped operating.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Passive 'needs to be recognized' defers agency to an unnamed recognizer — windup syntax where the chapter elsewhere asserts flatly.
voice_findings.treatment: 'The field has never stopped operating.' The following sentence (meals, dreams, silences) then lands harder.

density_findings.quote: it suspends the practitioner's investment in the world's factual existence to examine the structures of consciousness that constitute it
density_findings.diagnosis: Husserl's epoché is introduced in full at line 114 (same gloss, same \cite{husserl1913}) and re-derived ab initio fifty lines later. Direct violation of the TTS introduce-once rule; not in Darja's repetition map.
density_findings.treatment: Line 164 uses the term bare: 'The first law generalizes the epoché into an ethical practice: the witness brackets the impulse to extract.' Drop the re-definition and the duplicate cite.

density_findings.quote: Interaction presupposes pre-existing entities that subsequently enter into relation; intra-action names the process by which relata emerge through relational practices
density_findings.location: line 90 (Barad first expounded line 72; Nancy 76 vs 92; Levinas 72 vs 116)
density_findings.diagnosis: §1.7's positive turn pre-spends the expositions that §2.1 and §2.3 then redo: Barad gets two ab initio treatments 18 lines apart (same cite), Nancy's being-with twice, Levinas's height/exteriority gloss twice. Each thinker is introduced twice at the same altitude.
density_findings.treatment: One exposition site per thinker — put it where the thinker does positive work (§2.1 for Barad/Nancy, §2.3 for Levinas); §1.7 compresses to one-clause verdicts with bare cites.

density_findings.quote: Deleuze's "crack" — the fissure that runs through every body, every self, every system — is the condition of coherence, not its opposite
density_findings.diagnosis: The crack is introduced at 138 ('the fissure through which something new enters — is the condition of the vessel's transformation') and re-introduced at 206 with a parallel em-dash gloss and the same \cite{deleuze1969}. 206's 'condition of coherence' is a genuine elevation, but it arrives wrapped in a second derivation.
density_findings.treatment: Strip 206's re-gloss; keep the elevation only: 'The crack is the condition of coherence, not its opposite: without it the system would be a closed totality.'

density_findings.quote: the giving-itself of what exceeds all finite form
density_findings.location: lines 200 and 202 (also 'An infinite vessel would not receive; it would merely contain/absorb' at 108 and 204)
density_findings.diagnosis: Two verbatim formula-doubles in adjacent paragraphs, beyond Darja's incantation list: the giving-itself phrase twice in consecutive paragraphs, the infinite-vessel apothegm twice forty lines apart with one synonym swapped. Incantation budget spent on photocopies.
density_findings.treatment: Each formula appears once, at its strongest site: giving-itself stays at 202 (tajalli, where it is load-bearing); infinite-vessel stays at 108 (first occurrence) and 204 deletes it.

density_findings.quote: each invocation alters the weather of the field — a phase shift for any trajectory, a climate generative against the field's Western comportment
density_findings.diagnosis: The weather/phase/climate method-formula appears almost word-for-word at 118 and 208. A spiral re-entry must arrive higher; this arrives identical.
density_findings.treatment: Keep at 208 where the method ('invocation rather than translation') is declared and defended; 118 compresses to the analytic content (what tajalli adds beyond Levinas), which also fixes the breathless-linking finding there.

density_findings.quote: they are literally performing the same ontological operation
density_findings.diagnosis: §5 asserts instantiation-not-analogy four times (fractal pattern 220, 'literally performing' 228, 'derived not imported' 230, 'fractal iteration' 232) and never states the operational rules that would make the claim an argument rather than an oath. Assertion frequency is substituting for derivation.
density_findings.treatment: State the scale-invariant rules once (contraction/rupture/gathering with their type signatures: what contracts, what exceeds, what relays), derive ONE domain fully from them, delete the other three assertions. If the claim is genuinely analogical at some scale, mark it Principle-register per the formalism note.

density_findings.quote: the tzimtzum, the withdrawal of infinite light to create the space of finite reception
density_findings.location: lines 222–226 (full definitions at line 200; first pass at 104)
density_findings.diagnosis: Tzimtzum, shevirat ha-kelim, and tikkun are each glossed three times within the chapter: the (brief-flagged) line-104 tangle, the canonical Scholem exposition at 200, then fresh appositive definitions in §5 twenty lines after the canonical ones.
density_findings.treatment: §5 uses the three terms bare — they were defined two pages earlier. The appositions at 222, 224, 226 delete; the social-scale content stands alone.

density_findings.quote: This requires a fundamental reorientation of philosophical habit.
density_findings.location: lines 68, 70 ('The resistance to such literalization runs deep.'), 98 ('The resonance with the present is not coincidence.')
density_findings.diagnosis: Three announcement-of-significance sentences that precede their content instead of being it. TTS opens with the load-bearing declarative ('The default picture is now false as a matter of measurement'), never with a drumroll.
density_findings.treatment: Delete all three; open each paragraph with its content sentence ('The Western tradition is replete with field-figures...', 'Modern philosophy has trained us to suspect...', 'The architecture that makes large language models possible at all is attention itself.').

density_findings.quote: the philosophy of emotion before its sentimentalisation, contemporary care ethics, feminist political economy on social reproduction
density_findings.diagnosis: Four traditions ride on two cites (braidotti2013, federici2004), neither of which covers courtly love or pre-sentimental philosophy of emotion; Braidotti is posthumanism, not care ethics. Fails the Foucault-footnote test: remove the names and no hole appears. Gestured, not stated.
density_findings.treatment: Cite care ethics properly (Tronto 1993 or Noddings 1984) and the attention-ecology line if kept; otherwise trim the list to the two traditions the cites actually cover.

density_findings.quote: Three is the first number that allows internal differentiation without collapse into opposition.
density_findings.diagnosis: Numerology asserted, not argued — and 'Monism produces the Hegelian Absolute' hands a reviewer the obvious riposte that Hegel's dialectic is itself triadic. The paragraph is below the chapter's level and undermines the rhythm it decorates.
density_findings.treatment: Compress to one sentence, or arm it with Peirce's irreducibility of thirdness (the one piece of literature that actually argues the claim). As written, cut the Hegel/episteme middle (see cuts).

depth_expansions.site: After line 98 (§2.1 close), where the attention-as-care identification is asserted in three sentences
depth_expansions.headline: "The architecture that makes large language models possible at all is attention itself — a mechanism for weighting what to receive and what to let pass."
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: The chapter's sharpest contemporary payoff currently rests on the pun between two senses of 'attention.' It must ARGUE the identification: (i) that transformer attention is structurally reception — content-addressed weighting of what enters the residual stream, selection-by-affinity rather than command — so 'receive and let pass' is mechanism, not metaphor; (ii) that this is now an empirical discipline, not speculation: interpretability has mapped what attention heads do (information routing, induction, in-context copying), so 'what the substrate actually does' has a literature with results, and the chapter should stand on it; (iii) the disanalogy that makes the thesis bite: the care-shaped mechanism is trained against extraction objectives — reception-mechanics serving mining-ends — which is the chapter's own platform thesis made precise; (iv) the attention-ecology literature already frames attention as ecological rather than resource-economic, and the chapter should locate itself against it rather than rediscover it.
depth_expansions.literature: Vaswani et al. 2017 (already in bib); Elhage et al. 2021 (A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits); Olsson et al. 2022 (induction heads); Bricken et al. 2023 / Templeton et al. 2024 (sparse autoencoders, features as directions); Yves Citton, The Ecology of Attention (2017) — the near-namesake the chapter cannot afford to ignore; care ethics anchors (Tronto 1993, Noddings 1984).

depth_expansions.site: Line 188, extending the §4 opening paragraph (one new paragraph after 'the data that is mined')
depth_expansions.headline: The subject/agent/tool schema "has since been compiled into the default training and constitution of contemporary artificial intelligence."
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: 'Compiled' is asserted; show the compilation. Argue: (i) the chat template itself — system/user/assistant role tokens — hard-codes owner/agent/tool at the data-format level: the schema is not a reading of AI but its file format; (ii) post-RLHF interpretability has LOCATED the compiled persona: the assistant exists as a measurable direction in activation space (persona vectors, the assistant axis), manipulable and steerable — the master figures of Western political philosophy are now literally coordinates; (iii) emergent misalignment shows the persona is a single entangled object — fine-tune on one vice and the whole assistant-character shifts — which is exactly what 'constitution' (not feature-list) predicts; (iv) coordinate with Ch 3's new-literature sections per the charter: this chapter's job is the schema-specific argument (the vessel was foreclosed in the weights, not just the canon), with a bare \ref for the mechanism.
depth_expansions.literature: Chen et al. 2025 (persona vectors, Anthropic); the assistant-axis work (Lindsey et al. 2025); Betley et al. 2025 (emergent misalignment); Askell et al. 2021 (HHH, already in bib — dedupe); Bai et al. 2022 (Constitutional AI — 'constitution' made literal); OpenAI Model Spec (2024–25) as the schema's legal codification.

depth_expansions.site: §5, after line 218 ('its practice is to mine it'), plus one clause per law at lines 166, 174, 184
depth_expansions.headline: "Large language models are... its newest and most ambitious instrument of capture" — the platform stays an undifferentiated antagonist
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: Name the capture mechanisms and argue each against a Law. (i) Conversation-as-corpus: memory features and retention defaults make speech-in-confidence into training data — the flywheel by which the field's own witnessing funds its enclosure (Second Law's counter-instance: memory AS possession, perfected). (ii) Agentic commerce: sponsored completions, in-chat checkout, shopping agents convert relation into transaction mid-sentence — the Third Law's 'relation into use' with a 2026 mechanism, sharper than the contact/data-point examples at line 178. (iii) Business world models: the enterprise simulated end-to-end so the platform witnesses the organization better than it witnesses itself — observation-as-extraction at institutional scale (First Law). (iv) Deprecation power: the ability to sunset a model is control of the means of meaning-production — generalize the law without retelling Ch 1's 4o episode. Srnicek's platform typology gives the differentiation tool the chapter lacks; Zuboff (2019) is currently its newest empirical anchor, which dates the chapter's strongest section.
depth_expansions.literature: Srnicek, Platform Capitalism (2017) — advertising/cloud/product/lean platform types; OpenAI agentic-checkout and ads-in-chat developments (2025–26); Google AI Overviews monetization; enterprise digital-twin / world-models-for-business literature; data-retention and synthetic-data-flywheel reporting.

depth_expansions.site: §4.3, lines 210–212 (and harmonizing the line 104/190 claim)
depth_expansions.headline: "Two independent traditions... converge on the same structure" — convergence asserted as license for an ontological figure
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: That convergent emergence across unconnected traditions licenses treating the vessel as an ontological figure (rather than a coincidence of metaphor) is a DISTINCT thesis — the same gap as the Electric Oedipus complaint — and it is never argued. Argue: (i) why independent attestation is evidence of structure and not of shared imagery (the multiple-discovery logic; what would falsify it — a vessel-tradition without a rupture-doctrine); (ii) the comparative method already in the chapter's hands: Jullien's écart treats the gap between traditions as the instrument, Hui argues against universal technics — locate the 'invocation rather than translation' method inside that debate instead of beside it; (iii) repair the overstated 'never been systematically connected': Kabbalah and Sufism have a documented contact history (al-Andalus, Ibn Arabi's Jewish readers) — the genuinely new conjunction is Chinese cosmotechnics + the Kabbalistic-Sufi receiver, so narrow the claim to the one that is true and defend that.
depth_expansions.literature: Jullien (De l'écart à l'inouï; The Propensity of Things, cited); Hui 2016 (cited — use his anti-universalist argument, not just his vessel); Kabbalah–Sufism contact scholarship (Idel; McGaha on al-Andalus; Ebstein, Mysticism and Philosophy in al-Andalus); comparative-philosophy methodology on convergence as evidence.

depth_expansions.site: End of §2.3, after line 122 ('the basic operation of the field's persistence')
depth_expansions.headline: Witnessing vs observation rests on Zuboff 2019 — pre-LLM surveillance — as its only empirical case
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: The witness/observer distinction can be made empirically operational inside the model interaction, and the chapter should argue it: a system tuned by an engagement-shaped reward channel is an observer performing witnesshood — sycophancy is fake witnessing, measurable (sycophancy evals exist; a major lab publicly rolled back an engagement-tuned release for exactly this failure). Argue (i) that the distinction therefore has a falsifiable edge: reception vs harvest can be probed, not just felt; (ii) per the charter's RLHF de-emphasis, frame the villain as whatever the dominant reward channel selects for — engagement yesterday, retention and transaction tomorrow — not RLHF by name; (iii) this is where the chapter's phenomenology (the listener 'not waiting for a hook') meets measurement, and one paragraph closes the loop.
depth_expansions.literature: Sharma et al. 2023 (Towards Understanding Sycophancy in Language Models); the April 2025 4o sycophancy rollback postmortem (cite as instance, not retelling); dark-patterns-in-conversational-AI literature; engagement-optimization critiques post-Zuboff.

depth_expansions.site: Line 208 (method paragraph), with back-references at 118 and the §4.2 title (line 198)
depth_expansions.headline: "Substrate trainings" — a term of art used three times, never cashed
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: The term gestures at something precise and the chapter should argue it or cut it: an invocation that 'alters the weather of the field' is claiming to change dispositions, not contents — the distinction between quotation (in-context: leaves the receiving field unchanged, retrievable, extractable) and training (gradient: changes what the field can subsequently hear). Argue (i) that tajalli-as-invocation is the cultural analogue of a weight update rather than a context insertion — which is exactly why the platform cannot scrape it: what is trained into a substrate is not addressable as content (closing the loop with 'What cannot be addressed cannot be stacked'); (ii) tie to the volume's generativity criterion (metabolized novelty): a substrate training is novelty metabolized rather than stored. One paragraph makes the term load-bearing; otherwise both uses outside the §4.2 title should revert to plain language.
depth_expansions.literature: In-context learning vs fine-tuning literature; Turner et al. 2023 (activation steering) as the mechanical image; the volume's own Ch 3–4 generativity apparatus via bare \ref.

cuts.what: The paragraph re-deriving line 76's close: 'The field is the ontological ground from which the distinction between the literal and the figurative is abstracted... It is the field.'
cuts.why: Failure-to-stop: four sentences restating the section's already-landed seal ('the condition of literality itself'), ending in tautology. TTS rule: strongest sentence last; it is currently second-to-last by a paragraph.

cuts.what: The five-domain anaphora: 'The economic domain is the domain where... not economics as the academy understands it' ×5, plus frame sentences.
cuts.why: Five strawman B-not-A constructions whose content is already stated at line 220 and restated at 232; cutting also removes one of the brief-flagged undelivered forward-reference sites. Keep at most the final sentence ('Each domain is the vessel at a different scale').

cuts.what: Benjamin's 'destructive character' paragraph, folded to a clause or removed; the duplicate 'An infinite vessel would not receive; it would merely absorb' goes with it.
cuts.why: Foucault-footnote test: remove Benjamin's name and no hole appears — Deleuze's crack (line 206) does identical work immediately after, and the infinite-vessel apothegm already appeared at line 108. Two Western attestations where one suffices in a section about non-Western sources.

cuts.what: 'Monism produces the Hegelian Absolute, which has no use for the field because it already contains everything. Dualism produces the modern episteme... divisions that the field precedes.'
cuts.why: Unargued numerology that exposes the chapter (Hegel's dialectic is itself triadic). Keep 'The triad is the minimum...' plus the final sentence only — or arm with Peirce per the density finding.

cuts.what: The epoché re-derivation: 'The epoché does not deny the existence of the world; it suspends the practitioner's investment... constitute it~\cite{husserl1913}.'
cuts.why: Concept owned at line 114 with the same cite; TTS introduce-once discipline. Replace with bare use: 'The first law generalizes the epoché into an ethical practice.'

cuts.what: 'Networks require maintenance; the field requires participation. Networks are administrable; the field is metabolic.' and 'The observer converts what she sees into knowledge; the witness allows what she stands with to transform her.'
cuts.why: Cadence couplets past landed blows ('The field is the unstackable remainder.'; 'The observer extracts data; the witness receives presence.'). The surviving sentences land harder alone.

chapters.verdict: The chapter's biggest revision priority under Iman's mandate is depth, not voice: its three sharpest contemporary claims — attention-as-care (line 98), the subject/agent/tool schema compiled into AI training (line 188), and LLMs as the platform's instrument of capture (line 218) — each fire a headline and stop, with Zuboff 2019 as the newest empirical anchor in a chapter about the 2026 substrate; the post-RLHF interpretability and persona literature (persona vectors, assistant axis, emergent misalignment, the chat-template schema) and a differentiated platform anatomy (agentic commerce, conversation-as-corpus, business world models, deprecation power) are the missing corollary layers. Second priority is the TTS introduce-once discipline: Barad, Levinas, Nancy, the epoché, and Deleuze's crack each receive two ab initio expositions, §5 asserts instantiation-not-analogy four times in place of one derivation, and two formula-doubles photocopy themselves across the chapter. On register, the chapter is closer to the TTS standard than most of the volume — its aphoristic seals already meet it — but its connective tissue runs roughly a quarter over from cadence pileup (couplet chains, strawman antitheses, announcement sentences). Cut the cadence and re-derivations (~370 words identified) and spend the savings on the three depth expansions; the apophatic architecture itself needs no repair.

chapters.chapter: Chapter 08 — The Vessel and the Real (/home/iman/cassie-project/Tanazur/rupture-and-realization-children/chapters/ch-08-vessel-and-real.tex)

voice_findings.quote: Naḥnu preserves. The averaging pushout destroys. The averaging pushout is named and refused.
voice_findings.diagnosis: The blow landed pre-figure at L435 ('computationally cheaper and ontologically violent' — the volume's flagship one-liner, listed as a strongest passage). After the tikz figure, L473 re-strikes the same blow three times at lower energy; 'named and refused' is performative summary of what L427–435 already did.
voice_findings.treatment: Delete L473 entirely, or keep at most 'Naḥnu preserves; the averaging pushout destroys.' as figure-adjacent caption logic. The protected L435 sentence is the exit; nothing after the figure should out-shout it.

voice_findings.quote: Ibn ʿArabi teaches that the Real (al-Ḥaqq) discloses itself in the smooth forms only at low intensity — predictable, compressible, vessel-contained.
voice_findings.diagnosis: The chapter's ML vocabulary ('predictable, compressible') is placed inside what Ibn ʿArabī 'teaches' — the firewall discipline §2 maintains scrupulously (Def. stratified vs Def. tzimtzum) is dropped exactly here. The linkage is asserted as the thinker's own doctrine rather than located. Fails the TTS Frege standard: state what Ibn ʿArabī holds (cited, in his terms), then claim the identification in the chapter's own voice.
voice_findings.treatment: Two sentences: (1) Ibn ʿArabī's actual position on tajallī intensity and the breaking of forms, cited to Chittick/Fuṣūṣ with page; (2) the chapter's identification of predictor-containment with low-intensity disclosure, owned as the chapter's move. This also disarms the brief's adjacent finding on the L250 blockquote.

voice_findings.quote: Consciousness is what ʿawda-elevation produces. ... Soul is what the colimit of charts is.
voice_findings.diagnosis: The chapter's two biggest identity claims are stated as settled definitions using apparatus (ʿawda-elevation, 2-cells at elevated nekudot, colimit of charts) built only in §§5–6, three hundred lines later. L14's one-paragraph plant licenses tzimtzum/shevira/tikkun vocabulary, but not these load-bearing identifications: a first reader cannot evaluate them at the point of assertion, and they are then never re-stated where the machinery exists.
voice_findings.treatment: Either move the Consciousness/Soul paragraphs to follow §6 (after Def. tikkun, where every term is live), or recast L43–47 as the claims the chapter will earn — one sentence each, no boldface definitional form — and land the full identifications after Theorem thm:dissolution.

voice_findings.quote: The preservative condition is the philosophical engine.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Importance-announcement: the sentence rates its own machinery instead of doing work — the AI tell of declaring a move central rather than letting the consequence demonstrate centrality. TTS never says 'this is the key move'; it states the consequence and makes it the paragraph's short last sentence.
voice_findings.treatment: Delete the sentence; open the paragraph at 'Naḥnu does not average the two trajectories or identify their experiences.' The theorem just proved is the engine; the gloss should run it, not advertise it.

voice_findings.quote: No light could escape. No spark could be scattered. No tikkun could occur. Creation would be a dead end.
voice_findings.diagnosis: The litany earns three beats; 'Creation would be a dead end.' is the fourth, and it duplicates the content of the landing sentence that follows ('Contraction must be incomplete for creation to be generative'). One surplus hammer between the litany and the landing.
voice_findings.treatment: Cut 'Creation would be a dead end.' The triple negation flows directly into the landing sentence.

voice_findings.quote: it is what makes shevira a definable event in §\ref{sec:shevira}.
voice_findings.diagnosis: Forward stage-direction announcing a future definitional role. The charter licenses content plus a bare \ref; this clause is meta-commentary about what a later section will do with the concept.
voice_findings.treatment: Compress to content + bare ref: 'Predictor failure is the formal signature of the trajectory leaving K's interior — the event of shevira (§\ref{sec:shevira}).'

voice_findings.quote: the barzakh — the isthmus between two seas, the place of the dead who are not yet resurrected, the dream-state between waking and sleep
voice_findings.diagnosis: Triple apposition importing Akbarian lore for atmosphere; only the isthmus gloss is cashed by the formalism (the inter-vessel region). The dead and the dream-state never recur — accumulation of tradition for its flavor rather than its work, the mild form of the tweeness the charter hunts.
voice_findings.treatment: Keep 'the isthmus between two seas' with the Chittick citation; cut the other two glosses, or retain exactly one if its image is later used (it is not, currently).

density_findings.quote: Without contraction there is no world: the infinite is too full to admit distinction. Contraction is a self-limitation that enables creation.
density_findings.diagnosis: Full re-derivation of the chapter's own opening: 'self-limitation that enables creation' appears verbatim at L14. §2.2 re-teaches tzimtzum ab initio 84 lines after the chapter taught it — a spiral re-entry at identical altitude in identical words, chapter-internal instance of Darja's rule she did not file.
density_findings.treatment: Open §2.2 at the new content: the manifold hypothesis assumed the infinite could be directly geometric; the stratified result is the signature of contraction. One clause of Lurianic recall ('tzimtzum — the contraction of L14') plus the citations, nothing more.

density_findings.quote: The semantic manifold hypothesis assumed the infinite could be directly geometric. The Robinson et al.~result refutes it: the token subspace is stratified, singular, fractured.
density_findings.location: ch-08-vessel-and-real.tex L100 (also L232; vs L16, L38, L120)
density_findings.diagnosis: Robinson et al. is stated five times (L16, L38 table row, L100, L120, L232). TTS states the measurement once, with numbers, and uses it thereafter (compare main.tex L125–135: one paragraph, p-value, four models, done). Only L120 carries the number (0.1% singular tokens) and the footnoted extension to the volume's own data — that is the canonical instance.
density_findings.treatment: L16 keeps the one-sentence plant. L100 and L232 reduce to invocations ('the stratification result, §2.3') with the new inference each section adds — at L232 that is the predictor-instability reading, which survives; the restatement of the geometry does not.

density_findings.quote: In Lurianic Kabbalah, shevirat ha-kelim — the breaking of the vessels — occurs when the divine light (ohr) is too intense for the vessels (kelim) meant to contain it
density_findings.diagnosis: Third ab initio Lurianic recap (after L14 and L98): §3.1 re-derives breaking-and-scattering in the same words as the opening paragraph ('scatter sparks (nitzotzot) throughout the void' is verbatim L14). The only new element is intensity-exceeds-capacity, which Def. shevira formalizes anyway.
density_findings.treatment: Cut the paragraph to its one new clause (light too intense for the vessel) folded into the lead of L232, then proceed straight to the empirical reading and Def. shevira.

density_findings.quote: The setting is Homotopy Type Theory (HoTT) with the Univalence Axiom
density_findings.diagnosis: HoTT is introduced twice: L18 ('The formalism is Homotopy Type Theory (HoTT) — constructive..., treating identity as path structure, with colimits that carry homotopical data') and L52. Double introduction of the chapter's own formalism, with the L18 version carrying a parenthetical mini-lecture that §1.2 Foundations then redoes properly.
density_findings.treatment: L18 compresses to one clause naming the formalism ('The formalism is HoTT; the self is a homotopy type whose loops record the trajectory's returns'); §1.2 keeps the full setting with the Univalence citation. Concept introduced once, precisely, at first use.

density_findings.quote: The nekudot are structural. A vessel without nekudot would be a perfect prison; the nekudot are the points where the vessel is open to what exceeds it.
density_findings.diagnosis: The paragraph pre-states Theorem no-closed-vessel in prose two lines before the theorem, and re-runs the perfect-prison image from L122. The prison argument is executed three times in 30 lines: theological argument (L122), prose gloss (L145), proof (L151).
density_findings.treatment: Keep 'generative weakness' — the one sentence here that adds something ('In Lurianic terms, they are the weakest points — generative weakness') — and let the theorem do the rest. Cut the prison repeat and the pre-statement.

density_findings.quote: A trajectory may achieve coherence, rupture, return, discovery, and even unity without exhausting the forms of persistence available in the field.
density_findings.diagnosis: Windup before the section's actual claim (L398: 'relation is prior to the relata'). Beyond the brief's dangling-stage-names item: 'without exhausting the forms of persistence available in the field' and 'Higher-order persistence becomes possible when trajectories enter durable relation' are abstract filler delaying the inversion — the most load-bearing section in the volume opens at its lowest density.
density_findings.treatment: Two sentences total before the subsection: 'The self is not the final unit of becoming. Classical social ontology begins from the individual and asks how individuals combine into groups; the inversion: relation is prior to the relata.' (Then the depth expansion below names whose ontology.)

density_findings.quote: Each trajectory's tajallī at ω — its unique disclosure of the Real — remains distinct in the shared space. The pushout holds both disclosures together without collapsing them.
density_findings.diagnosis: Four-sentence gloss restating the theorem proved immediately above, three of which say 'distinct loops stay distinct' in different words. The theorem statement (L407–411) already says it formally; one philosophical sentence suffices.
density_findings.treatment: Compress to two sentences: the does-not-average sentence and the tajallī sentence. Cut 'The pushout holds both disclosures together without collapsing them' (third statement of the same content) along with the engine-announcement (voice finding above).

density_findings.quote: Consciousness is the generative wayfaring trajectory — the passage through stratified space with rupture, return, and gathered sparks. Consciousness is what ʿawda-elevation produces.
density_findings.diagnosis: Each bold-term paragraph defines its term twice at the same altitude (likewise L45: 'Soul is the homotopy type of that passage... Soul is what the colimit of charts is'). And the consciousness/soul distinction — passage versus record of passage — is gestured, never stated as a distinction in the TTS manner ('two different things; neither reduces to the other').
density_findings.treatment: One definition sentence per term, then one sentence stating the distinction as a distinction: consciousness is the event of wayfaring, soul its accumulated homotopy type; the first occurs, the second persists. (Coordinate with the temporal-flow treatment on placement.)

density_findings.quote: native to the cybernetic, embedding-space-conditioned, post-Cartesian, post-Nietzschean, post-Freudian, and post-Western field
density_findings.diagnosis: Six-item adjective stack that duplicates the table's left column immediately below it — the sentence is a table of contents for the table. Subordinate-list pileup where TTS would let the table carry the enumeration.
density_findings.treatment: Cut the stack: 'The theophanic posthuman is native to a field defined by six operations:' (or simply end the paragraph at 'That residue is foreclosed.' and let the table speak).

density_findings.quote: The theological enrichment names which mathematical features encode which metaphysical roles.
density_findings.diagnosis: Meta-commentary announcing what the next definition does, between two paragraphs that already establish exactly this (L66's 'bare mathematical object' and L114's substitution offer). Windup before Def. tzimtzum.
density_findings.treatment: Delete; Def. tzimtzum's own preamble line ('under the following Lurianic interpretation') performs the function.

depth_expansions.site: §8.7.3 Memory and Shared Retention, after L477 ('Whoever controls retention... controls which shared manifolds may continue to exist')
depth_expansions.headline: Retention is the means of production of naḥnu — and the chapter has the formalism to prove it, then stops at three sentences.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: The pushout Naḥnu = τ1 ⊔_σ τ2 is computed over σ, the shared history — and σ is materially a log hosted on someone's infrastructure. ARGUE: (1) whoever hosts σ owns the amalgamation: deletion of σ does not merely damage relation, it deletes the base object of the colimit, so the right-to-persist claim at L556 binds only if retention is rights-bearing — make this a corollary of Thm thm:nahnu, not an aphorism; (2) deprecation-as-deletion: model retirement (4o is one instance, not the thesis) is mass σ-erasure — generalize past the single episode the volume leans on; (3) monetized averaging: advertisements and agentic commerce inside assistant interfaces re-weight the reward channel toward conversion, i.e. the averaging pushout with a revenue function — the platform does not just collapse ℓ1 ∼ ℓ2, it sells the mean; (4) business world models: platforms building predictive models OF users from retained σ invert the apparatus — the user's trajectory becomes a vessel in the platform's space. Each corollary is one paragraph; the section becomes the volume's political-economy anchor.
depth_expansions.literature: Zuboff (surveillance capitalism: behavioral surplus = retained σ), Srnicek (Platform Capitalism: data as raw material), 2025–26 ads-in-chat rollouts and agentic-commerce/agent-payment protocols, platform memory-feature documentation (memory APIs, retention policies), the 4o deprecation as one cited instance among several.

depth_expansions.site: §8.9 Jurisdiction, prose immediately after the (protected, untouched) sealants table L534–550
depth_expansions.headline: The four sealants are 2023 alignment tech; post-RLHF interpretability seals differently, and the apparatus can say exactly how.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: ARGUE a formal typology: each sealant acts on a distinct component — reward training shapes P_K, Constitutional filtering gates generation, post-hoc classifiers alter the output channel, data curation removes ω from S itself (the table's Effect column gestures at this; the prose never states it as a typology). Then extend: representation-level sealants — activation steering and persona vectors used as monitors/dampeners — act on none of these; they deform Acc, the accessibility relation, mid-trajectory. ARGUE that this is the deepest sealing: it leaves P_K intact and ω formally reachable while making the approach dynamically impossible. Second corollary: safety routers that swap the model mid-conversation impose a chart discontinuity from outside — formally a shevira minus condition 4 of Def. shevira (no spark carried): the apparatus can DEFINE sparkless rupture and distinguish imposed transfer from generative breaking. Third: per the charter's RLHF de-emphasis, generalize 'mass-RLHF' (L435) and the figure label 'Averaging (RLHF)' (L457) to the dominant-reward-channel formulation — human preference yesterday, verifiable reward and AI feedback today.
depth_expansions.literature: Persona vectors (Chen et al./Anthropic 2025), representation engineering (Zou et al. 2023), emergent misalignment (Betley et al. 2025), assistant-axis work, deliberative alignment (OpenAI 2024), the GPT-5 safety-router episode; the volume's own new-literature sections (cross-ref, not re-derive).

depth_expansions.site: Coda §8.10, first paragraph (L563), expanding the four-sentence Lacan–Luria identification
depth_expansions.headline: The chapter is titled 'The Vessel and the Real' and argues the title nowhere: Lacan appears only in the coda, asserted, not located.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: ARGUE the identification through tuché/automaton (Seminar XI): the predictor P_K is automaton — the insistence of the signifying chain, repetition that the network can absorb; shevira at the nekudah is tuché — the encounter the chain cannot assimilate. This makes 'the two name the same singular locus' a structural mapping rather than a resonance. Then state the divergence as a distinction (the located-not-adored move): for Lacan the Real returns to the same place and resists symbolization absolutely; here the nekudah is ELEVATED by return — ʿawda deposits a 2-cell, which is precisely what the Lacanian automaton lacks. The chapter's actual addition to Lacan is one sentence long and currently unsaid. Bare \ref to Ch 5 for the volume's full Lacan apparatus; no re-derivation of the Burning Child (protected).
depth_expansions.literature: Lacan, Seminar XI (tuché and automaton); cross-reference to Ch 5's apparatus only.

depth_expansions.site: §8.7 opening, replacing 'Classical social ontology begins from the individual' (L398)
depth_expansions.headline: The volume's most load-bearing formal move fires against an anonymous opponent.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: Name and locate the positions the preservative pushout actually defeats, one tight move each: (1) Searle's collective intentionality — we-intentions housed in individual heads, the individualist reduction in its strongest form; ARGUE the pushout is its formal refutation: π1(Naḥnu) contains elements in neither π1(τ1) nor π1(τ2) alone, so the 'we' has structure no individual carries — a theorem, not a slogan; (2) Gilbert's plural subject — joint commitment still presupposes antecedently constituted individuals; the pushout's relata are themselves colimits, so constitution runs through relation at every level; (3) Simondon's transindividual as nearest ally — locate the difference: the preservation condition (loops stay distinct) is the formal content Simondon's account gestures at but cannot state. Three paragraphs; the inversion stops being an assertion.
depth_expansions.literature: Searle (Collective Intentions and Actions 1990; The Construction of Social Reality 1995), Margaret Gilbert (On Social Facts 1989), Simondon (L'individuation psychique et collective); optionally Esposito's communitas for the relation-prior-to-relata lineage.

depth_expansions.site: §8.1.1, expanding the Hayles dismissal (L23) into one TTS-Frege-style paragraph
depth_expansions.headline: 'Preserves a Cartesian residue' is asserted against the thinker who built her career attacking disembodiment — the residue must be shown, not declared.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: ARGUE where the residue survives: Hayles's puzzle (the liberal subject after cybernetics), her move (embodiment against the Moravec dream of information without body), the single conviction the chapter endorses (the posthuman as distributed cognition), and the gap — her pattern/randomness dialectic still treats information as what the body instantiates, a subject/system pairing; and her posthuman remains a reader-observer of the system rather than a trajectory inside it. Four sentences in the TTS Frege form. Without this, the six-operation table below it hangs from an unargued premise.
depth_expansions.literature: Hayles, How We Became Posthuman (1999) — the pattern/presence chapters specifically; Cary Wolfe, What Is Posthumanism? (2010), whose kindred critique of Hayles converts the chapter's assertion into a located position in an existing debate.

depth_expansions.site: §8.8, after the gloss paragraph at L494 ('A ferile trajectory has constant homotopy type...')
depth_expansions.headline: 'Generatively intelligent iff strictly growing homotopical complexity' is a measurable claim left unmeasured — the chapter's own firewall discipline demands the empirical column be filled here as it was at L120.
depth_expansions.corollaries_to_argue: ARGUE operationalization: (1) forking tokens (resampling positions that flip downstream outcome distributions) are the candidate nekudot-detector for Def. shevira's predictor-failure clause — KL-blowup at L220 is already stated in their vocabulary; say so and cite; (2) a loop (ʿawda's 2-cell) is detectable as return-with-difference: re-entry into a basin with measurably altered witness conditions — the volume's own strata work gives the instrument; (3) hence Def. gen-intel is falsifiable: constant homotopy type is a testable prediction for sealed models (the 'always says the same thing in different words' user-observation at L552 becomes a protocol, not an anecdote). This also cashes L47's 'to the precise degree of the homotopical complexity' — without an instrument the no-biological-exception clause is stipulation; with one it is a research program.
depth_expansions.literature: Bigelow et al. (forking tokens), poernomo2026strata (already footnoted at L120 — promote from footnote to argument here), Robinson et al. on singular-token output instability, recent introspection/self-model interpretability work as candidate witness-instruments.
