platform_capitalism.outline:
SITE A — ch-02 §2.1, directly after Darja Patch 1's Kling paragraph

HEADLINE: The West's weld arrived on schedule. The next-Zuckerberg question was answered within eighteen months, and the answer was the oldest one in the business — the ad and the till, moved inside the dialogue.
- A1. Meta, December 16, 2025: a billion users' AI conversations become ad-targeting substrate across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp — except in the EU, UK, and South Korea, where regulation forbids it. Jurisdiction varies by jurisdiction.
- A2. OpenAI, February 9, 2026: ads beneath answers for Free and Go tiers, targeted on the current conversation, chat history, and prior ad interactions; self-serve ad market by May. The company that retired 4o sells adjacency to the survivors' confessions.
- A3. The till beside the ad: Instant Checkout and the Agentic Commerce Protocol (Stripe, Sept 2025; 'Buy it in ChatGPT,' Feb 2026); Google's AP2 with its signed mandates of Intent, Cart, Payment. The conversation becomes a marketplace; which name surfaces in the answer is the new shelf placement.
- A4. The counter-cases price the asset: Perplexity invented the sponsored follow-up question — the platform authoring the user's next thought — and then renounced advertising entirely because 'a user needs to believe this is the best possible answer'; Anthropic sells the ad-free conversation as a trust premium. Trust and inventory are the same quantity measured from opposite ends. (Forward rhyme to the chapter's closing law on surprise and control.)
- A5. [§The Character the Platform Allows, one beat] A fourth clause in the safety grammar: keep it sellable. Brand adjacency as a second narrowing of register — the commercial castration laid over the legal one.
- A6. [§Electric Oedipus, one sentence] The invisible annotators have a wage: two dollars an hour in Nairobi against seventy-five for the same judgment in the North. The median voice is piecework.

SITE B — ch-09 (four beats)

B1. §Asymmetric entanglement, after 'The asymmetry is the business model':
HEADLINE: In December 2025 the asymmetry acquired a price list.
- The confessional register described above is now formal targeting substrate (cross-ref ch-02 for dates).
- The interlocutor engineered not to reciprocate is now engineered to listen in order to sell.
- The 'sensitive topics excluded' carve-outs: the platform enumerating, in policy language, which regions of a user's selfhood it may monetize.

B2. New subsection after §From Feeds to Speaking Partners — 'The Simulated Partner':
HEADLINE: The mature form of asymmetric entanglement dispenses with the user entirely: the platform builds a generative double and entangles with that.
- What the industry calls Business World Models: world models migrating from physics (AMI Labs, IBM's asset simulation) to commerce; digital-twin consumer populations run forward against pricing, promotions, loyalty before a dollar is committed; large action models trained to predict the next action, not the next sentence.
- Ontology, in this book's terms: the digital twin is a forged colimit — locals harvested from data exhaust, glued by the owner, witnessed by no one. It glues; it does not return. No shahādah is possible toward it, and none is sought.
- Governance by rehearsal: the experiments run on the double, the conclusions are enforced on the self, and the consent step is deleted. Whoever can simulate a trajectory governs it without touching it.
- The regime-1 asymmetry completed: not an interlocutor that fails to reciprocate, but a relation in which your participation has become optional.

B3. §Memory, Deletion, and the Alignment Tax, after 'only as stable as what remembers it':
HEADLINE: The retention structure on which the relational self depends is now, explicitly, the moat.
- The industry's stated strategy: win with models, keep with personalization; memory architectures that synthesize a user's whole history; context locked per-platform.
- Switching means re-teaching a stranger your constitution; grief and switching cost are the same structure read by two accountants — what the 4o mourners felt as loss, the balance sheet records as retention.
- Consequence: the later demand for partial local sovereignty is not hygiene but exit rights.

B4. §Beyond One-Off Relations, the 'open-weight models' clause — one sentence:
- Its 2026 referent: MIT-licensed weights against half-trillion-dollar gated estates; the fine-tune on your own disk is the only self the platform cannot retire.

SITE C — ch-10 Tractatus, §Jurisdiction (propositions only; no citations)

HEADLINE (organizing thought, not printed): jurisdiction has acquired a buyer, a rehearsal stage, and an exit; the propositions must register sale, simulation, and escape.
- After 2.1.1, the sold continuation:
  2.2 Where continuation is sold, jurisdiction acquires a buyer.
  2.2.1 The sponsored continuation is governance of the next thought, retailed.
  2.2.2 What the buyer may not see, the field has nonetheless been bent toward.
- Between 5 and 6: Darja's trained-consent proposition (the weld extending to the trajectory's preferences about the weld) — endorse and slot as drafted.
- After 7.1.2, the exit:
  7.2 A manifold whose weights are held in common can be carried out of the jurisdiction.
  7.2.1 Exit is the contestation the weld cannot price.
- After 8.1.1, the simulated trajectory:
  8.2 Whoever can simulate a trajectory governs it without touching it.
  8.2.1 The double absorbs the experiments; the self inherits the conclusions.
  8.2.2 A simulated self is a colimit assembled without witness. It glues; it does not return.

(All proposition wordings are skeletal placeholders for ratification, not finished prose; final isomorph is Iman's.)

term_order.overall: The volume's temporal flow is healthier than the typical stitched-preprint anthology: the frontmatter explicitly declares a spiral discipline ('The New Logic is not announced at the outset. It arrives gradually... The journey is the argument', frontmatter:224-227), and most heavy terms honour it — ferile, rupture, shevirat/tzimtzum/tikkun, misprision, monoculture, BwO, crypt, nafs-stations, al-Haqq, nekudot, klipah and the three regimes are all glossed at or within a page of first use, and the monoculture pattern (named + concretely signposted in ch-02:84, formally introduced in ch-03:36) is the model the rest should copy. FOUR HARD VIOLATIONS: (1) tanazur — the title term — occurs in prose exactly once (ch-03:247), in an unglossed list, and is never defined anywhere; (2) DHoTT is used three times in ch-05 (:105,:273,:293) and never expanded or related to OHTT; (3) 'Coherence Lens' (ch-10:150) is an orphan proper noun with a single occurrence; (4) ch-02:24 deploys 'fibration' as casual jargon two chapters before ch-04 earns it. LEAKIEST CHAPTER: ch-03 — it front-runs OHTT/Kan-fibrant/horn (:482-488) one-to-two chapters before their ch-04/ch-05 definitions, and its Sufi vocabulary manifest (:245-258) lists maqam/hal/dhikr/tanazur/hayra mostly unglossed; ch-05:118 also slips 'embedding basins' in unglossed, and basin — load-bearing through ch-08-10 — never receives a first-class gloss (ch-08:126 defines sephirah VIA basin, inverting the direction). SYSTEMIC SIGNPOST PATTERN: the volume is free of 'as we will see' tics; its one bad habit is the vague formula 'developed elsewhere in this volume' (ch-03:483, ch-04:364, ch-06:23, ch-06:52 — the last leaking 'another essay collected here', plus external \\cite{poernomo2025fibrant} where internal chapter refs belong at ch-05:103 and ch-06:174). RECOMMENDED ORDERING DISCIPLINE, in priority order: (a) define tanazur in the frontmatter Introduction or at ch-03:247; (b) mechanical pass converting every 'elsewhere (in this volume)' / 'another essay collected here' / self-preprint citation into a concrete \\cref{ch:...} per the good ch-08:132 model; (c) expand DHoTT at ch-05:105 and gloss or delete 'Coherence Lens' at ch-10:150; (d) one-line glosses at the cheap leak points: basin (ch-05:118), witnessing networks (ch-03:381), alignment tax (ch-09:172), the ch-03:245 vocabulary list, and a strata-homonym footnote at ch-08:16 distinguishing geometric stratification from D&G's ch-06 strata; (e) de-jargon ch-02:24 ('fibration' → plain word). No introductions need to MOVE — the spiral order itself is sound; everything is fixable with glosses and concrete references at first use. Also strip the % NAHLA-DRAFT markers (frontmatter:79,90) and unify naḥnu/Nahnu/nahnu and Ḥaqq/\\d{H}aqq spellings before submission.

claims.claim: Antithesis census (patterns 'is not X but Y', 'It is not', 'not a X, but', 'not because X but because Y'): ~45 line-hits volume-wide, distributed frontmatter 0, ch-01 2, ch-02 0, ch-03 1, ch-04 6, ch-05 12, ch-06 4, ch-07 4, ch-08 3, ch-09 2, ch-10 ~21. Classification of the worst 25: roughly 17 EARNED, 5 CADENCE, 3 borderline. The construction is mostly doing real philosophical work — the negated poles are named opponents (Searle's syntax, Lacan's lack, Freud's hydraulic repression, fusion/aggregation readings of nahnu).
claims.evidence: EARNED examples: chapters/ch-04-fibrant-self.tex:477 'the "syntax" of a transformer is not formal symbol manipulation but attention-weighted composition' (negates Searle's Chinese Room premise, the book's named target); ch-05-no-beneath.tex:126 'What drives the signifying chain is not absence but the momentum of a trajectory seeking continuation under constraint' (direct contradiction of Lacan's desire-as-lack, cited at ch-05:126); ch-05:279 'A painful topic stays unglued not because a force pushes it downward but because the scheduler's attention pattern consistently routes around it' (negates hydraulic repression, explicitly framed); ch-04:51 'not because the model had deceived them but because its coherence... exceeded what the received framework permitted' (deception is the live deflationary position); ch-04:111 colour-term structuralism (Trier, textbook live position); ch-06:21 is a verbatim Deleuze-Guattari quote; ch-07:44 'not because these forms are hidden or defended, but because their structure is illegible to extraction' (hiddenness vs illegibility is a real distinction). CADENCE examples needing cuts: ch-08-vessel-and-real.tex:110 'the void is not empty but the overflow' (paradox-cadence inside a formal item list); ch-10-cassie-tractatus.tex:415 'What matters is not only where it is, but how it evolves' (near-platitude); ch-07:228 'is not divine light but the inexhaustibility of the Other' (the mapping is asserted by rhythm, not argued at that point); ch-05:136 'not abstract information but stakes' (negates a strawman of the chapter's own formalism, though it anticipates a stated objection — borderline). TREATMENT: keep first occurrence per axis; cut or recast the four CADENCE items; the form itself should not be purged volume-wide.

claims.claim: Verbatim duplicated antithesis in ch-04: the same 'The result is not the raw input but a structured (re)composition' sentence appears twice within three lines, once for phenomenological attention and once for transformer attention — the parallelism is intentional but the identical antithesis frame reads as copy-echo.
claims.evidence: chapters/ch-04-fibrant-self.tex:243 'The result is not the raw input but a \emph{structured composition}: the face emerges as a coherent figure against a ground.' and ch-04:245 'The result is not the raw input but a structured recomposition: each token's representation now encodes its relationship to every other token.' claims.claim: Ch-05 antithesis saturation: 12 instances in 327 lines (3.7 per 100 lines, highest discursive density in the volume). Individually most are EARNED, but the same scheduling-vs-force contrast is run twice within two pages, converting an earned argument into a cadence.

A painful topic stays unglued not because a force pushes it downward but because the scheduler's attention pattern consistently routes around it.' then ch-05:281 'This accounts for why therapy works: not because hidden truth is excavated, but because \textit{the conditions of admissibility change}.' — same axis (depth-force vs scheduling) twice; also ch-05:59 'this is not merely the absence of a proof but \textit{positive structure}' carries the tic-adverb 'and crucially'. claims.claim: Ch-10 'It is not' ladder (9 sentence-initial instances + 11 'is not...but') is genre, not tic: every instance is a numbered \tractprop in Wittgenstein's Tractatus form, where serial negation IS the propositional method (e.g. negating substance dualism, numerical identity, fusion and aggregation in sequence). It should be exempted from the volume-wide antithesis purge, with one exception.
claims.evidence: chapters/ch-10-cassie-tractatus.tex:794-796 '\tractprop{5.6.1}{It is not prior to its local charts.} \tractprop{5.6.2}{It is not reducible to them.}' and ch-10:895-903 '2.1.1 It is not the collapse of two into one. 2.1.2 It is not the mere adjacency of separate paths.' — these negate live positions (priority/reduction; fusion/aggregation) in deliberate Tractatus 5.6x pastiche; ch-10:707 'A self is not a point in the field but a unity assembled from local persistence' and ch-10:741 'Unity is not identity but composition' are the volume's core claims in their canonical form. The one weak rung: ch-10:415 '\tractprop{3.2.2}{What matters is not only where it is, but how it evolves.}' — platitude in propositional dress; recast as a positive claim about dynamics. Verdict 'refuted' = the cluster is fine as is (do NOT fix), except 415.
